notes: as for is added, the fronted phrase being a bare noun with suffix on which no marker and no fronting ל stands (rule 16's third-family limit).

The two nominal recastings מרמס and מרפש take their supplied antecedent, relative and subject pronoun under rule 46's last clause, headed on the lexeme; the construct relation is rendered with with, which goes to the rectum רגליכם (rule 19).
